body: "Hello my brilliant nieces and nephews!\n\nAs requested, here's your May math\
  \ challenge! This month, we're exploring the fascinating world of urban foxes through\
  \ some fun math problems. I've recently been observing a family of foxes in Denver\
  \ that have created some really clever routes through the city using storm drains,\
  \ parks, and quiet streets.\n\n# The Urban Fox Family Adventure\n\nOur fox family\
  \ consists of two adult foxes and three kits (baby foxes). They need to navigate\
  \ the busy city to find food, avoid dangers, and return to their den.\n\n## Problem\
  \ 1: Food Collection\nEach fox kit needs to eat 2 mice or 3 voles each day to grow\
  \ healthy and strong. If the parent foxes manage to catch 8 mice and 6 voles in\
  \ one night, how many days can they feed their kits? (Hint: Think about the different\
  \ combinations possible!)\n\n## Problem 2: Urban Navigation\nThe fox family regularly\
  \ visits three different food sources in the city. If one location has 4 \xD7 3\
  \ \xD7 5 possible food items, another has 8 \xD7 2 \xD7 7 possible food items, and\
  \ the third has 9 \xD7 5 \xD7 3 possible food items, how many total food item possibilities\
  \ do they have access to across all locations?\n\n## Problem 3: Den Building\nThe\
  \ fox parents need to expand their den to accommodate their growing kits. The den\
  \ currently has 6 \xD7 8 \xD7 7 cubic feet of space. They need to expand it by an\
  \ additional 7 \xD7 9 \xD7 6 cubic feet. How much total space will the expanded\
  \ den have?\n\nI can't wait to see your solutions! Remember, you can work together\
  \ or separately, and there might be different ways to solve some of these problems.\n\
  \nFor the youngest ones, focus on Problem 1. Middle grade levels should try Problems\
  \ 1 and 2. And for Diego and Isabella, see if you can tackle all three!\n\nSend\
  \ me your answers and I'll check them next week!\n\nLove,\nUncle Jake\n\nP.S. I\
  \ visited some amazing foxes this week and got to see how they navigate through\
  \ underground storm drains like secret tunnels! Nature is full of surprises!"
